# Attribute-Scaled Added Elemental Damage ("Adds A-B Damage [to Attacks/Spells] per N Strength/Dexterity")

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** breakpoint, step-function, damage-pool

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Two shapes, both floor(attribute_total/N) x per-1-point min/max: (1) UNSCOPED - Ralph's Burial ("Adds 1-6 Lightning Damage per 10 Dexterity") and Magnus' Jealousy ("Adds 2-5 Fire Damage per 10 Strength"), armor pieces whose raw affix text carries NO scope qualifier. Owner-confirmed 2026-09-02: applies to BOTH Attacks and Spells, never Minions - added to both {type}_attack_dmg_flat_{min,max} and {type}_spell_dmg_flat_{min,max}. End-to-end folded-value math spot-checked manually (55 Strength, unit 10, per-unit .25/.45 -> 12.5/22.5 on both attack and spell pools) but not confirmed against a live client. (2) SCOPED - Tower Sequence weapon nodes ("Adds 2 - 2 Fire Damage to Attacks per 10 Strength", "Adds 1 - 7 Lightning Damage to Attacks per 10 Dexterity"), local weapon mods that carry an explicit "to Attacks/Spells/Attacks and Spells" scope word - credited ONLY to the scoped class(es), added via bug-277 (2026-09-10) after a user report that the mod resolved as a flat non-scaling +2 fire instead of scaling with Strength (root cause: _CUSTOM_ADDS_RE had no end-anchor and swallowed the "...to Attacks" prefix before the per-attribute regex ever ran). KNOWN GAP (bug-278, disclosed not fixed): the SAME tower_sequence.json file also has an Armor-divisor variant ("Adds 1 - 1 Physical Damage to Attacks per 2260 Armor", "Adds 2 - 2 Physical Damage to Attacks per 2260 Armor") that hits the identical _CUSTOM_ADDS_RE truncation bug and is NOT covered by bug-277's fix - the new regex's attribute group is Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence only. Extending to Armor needs its own investigation first: unlike the three raw attributes, Armor's total isn't read anywhere in engine.compute's aggregate loop at the point this fold runs (it's a derived defensive stat resolved elsewhere), so floor(armor_total/2260) may not be safely available at this stage without checking for an iterative-solve ordering issue.
